description: This course covers the main concepts of data engineering, which covers data pipeline, data organization, efficient analysis of large data volumes, distributed data storage (depending on the system architecture, e.g., multi-core systems, multiprocessor systems, clusters), distributed and parallel data analysis, and map / reduce techniques and their generalization to distributed query processing.
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must have completed 1 of BT2102/CS2102 at a grade of at least D )
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) BT2102:D, CS2102:D)
title: Data Engineering
